title: Human Values Matter: Investigating How Misalignment Shapes Collective Behaviors in LLM Agent Communities
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally centered on evaluating and modeling agent morality and ethics using the Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values. It utilizes value-based benchmarks (PVQ and ValueBench) and investigates how different moral orientations (such as benevolence, universalism, and tradition) shape the behaviors of LLM agents.
